citations.quote: Place the integrity of the investment profession and the interests of clients above their own personal interests.
The Code and Standards should be viewed and interpreted as an interwoven tapestry of ethical requirements.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Enumerates the six binding principles of the CFA Institute Code of Ethics and frames the seven Standards-of-Professional-Conduct headings (I-VII) as the testable conduct rules that operationalize the Code; both are voluntarily adopted by Members and Candidates and enforced by the Professional Conduct Program.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
